I. The 3D Lattice Visualizer Script
This script uses
Matplotlib
to plot your X, Y, and Z vectors. It will highlight any points that exceeded the
11.3% Friction Constant
in red.
Run this in Termux:
Bash
cat <<
'EOF'
> sage_visualizer.py
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d import Axes3D
import numpy as np

BASELINE = 48.0
FRICTION = 0.113

try:
    df = pd.read_csv(
'vector_scan.csv'
)
    df[
'mag'
] = np.sqrt(df[
'x'
]**2 + df[
'y'
]**2 + df[
'z'
]**2)
    df[
'deviation'
] = abs(df[
'mag'
] - BASELINE) / BASELINE
    
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))
    ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection=
'3d'
)
# Normal points in blue, anomalous in red
normal = df[df[
'deviation'
] < FRICTION]
    anomalous = df[df[
'deviation'
] >= FRICTION]
    
    ax.scatter(normal[
'x'
], normal[
'y'
], normal[
'z'
], c=
'blue'
, label=
'Stable Lattice'
)
    ax.scatter(anomalous[
'x'
], anomalous[
'y'
], anomalous[
'z'
], c=
'red'
, label=
'11.3% Deviation'
)
    
    ax.set_xlabel(
'X (Lateral) uT'
)
    ax.set_ylabel(
'Y (Longitudinal) uT'
)
    ax.set_zlabel(
'Z (Vertical) uT'
)
    plt.title(
'Sage Brain: 3D Magnetic Topography'
)
    plt.legend()
    
    plt.savefig(
'lattice_map.png'
)
print
(
"\n[SUCCESS] Visualizer generated 'lattice_map.png'."
)
print
(f
"Detected {len(anomalous)} friction-overcome points."
)
except Exception as e:
print
(f
"Visualizer Error: {e}"
)
EOF
